---
name: implement-feature
description: Implement an explicitly assigned feature within the shared project rules.
---

Before editing, read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_TASKS.md`, and `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`; inspect the current Git status/branch and claim the assigned task with one owner and a bounded file list. Read the relevant architecture/security docs, source, and tests. Implement only the assigned scope, preserve user/agent work, add/update focused tests for behavior changes, and run applicable checks. Report exact commands/results, files, branch/commit, decisions, limitations, and next action in `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`. Do not change dependencies, security posture, or architecture without project-owner approval.
